newsitem.title: ITALY: Weak European economy, lira hurt Italy exports-Min.
newsitem.headline: Weak European economy, lira hurt Italy exports-Min.

text.p: The stronger lira and weak economy in key European trading partners are taking their toll on Italian exports, Foreign Trade Minister Augusto Fantozzi said in a statement on Thursday.
Data released earlier by national statistics office Istat said that exports in August to EU countries dipped to 10.53 trillion lire from 11.92 trillion in the same month last year.
Exports to non-EU countries eased to 12.06 trillion lire in September from a previous 12.85 trillion.

"It is too early to understand if these figures represent a genuine inversion of the trend seen in recent years," Fantozzi said. "Nonetheless it is undeniable that already for some months now, the lira gains and slowdown in European demand are breaking the expansion of our sales abroad." -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
